name: com.gameframex.unity.operationclipboard.alipayminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Clipboard (Alipay Mini Game)
description:
Alipay Mini Game clipboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationClipboard. Self-registers into OperationClipboardRegistry at startup via AliPayMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD macros are not enabled; installation implies registration). Clipboard APIs are JSON-callback based (enterprise mini games only for reading).

GameFrameX OperationClipboard 的支付宝小游戏粘贴板适配渠道包。通过 AliPayMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap 在启动阶段自注册进主包 OperationClipboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪，注册不会发生；引用即注册）。支付宝剪贴板 API 为 JSON 字符串回调（读取仅企业主体小程序可用）。
